title: Agent message
description: One agent-to-agent message: a short note plus references. Serialize as one line of compact UTF-8 JSON (ensure_ascii=False, no spaces); the serialized line must be <= 1000 bytes. The sender appends the exact line to messages/<role>--<agent-id>.jsonl before sending.

id.description: Role-qualified sender and sequence, e.g. rld--main-0001 or architect--root-0001. Every role has a separate log.

type.description: instruction: UI -> RLD, a registered user instruction. task: RLD -> assignee. delivery: assignee -> RLD, task result. question / reply: ask and answer. confirm_request: RLD -> UI, needs a user decision. ack: receipt only. alert: failure, blocker or integrity problem.

re.description: id of the message this one answers.

about.description: Database entity ids the message concerns (project, hypothesis, experiment, branch, decision, task). Documents such as instructions and literature notes go in docs.

text.description: Short note. Anything that affects a decision must be in a referenced document, not only here.

docs.description: Versioned document paths relative to docs/; each must be registered in the database.

need.description: What the sender expects back. decision is only for confirm_request.

agent.description: A fixed root role, registered advisor/reviewer, or hypothesis-bound worker address. Root work belongs only to architect/root.
